On top of everything else, we can’t afford these tariffs.

title: DSCC Releases New Digital Ad on Michael Whatley: “Can’t Be Trusted”
text:
Meet Michael Whatley.
DC insider…
Oil and gas lobbyist…
And Republican running for U.S. Senate in North Carolina.
Whatley built a career shmoozing with billionaires and doing the bidding of massive corporations.
Whatley got paid…
His corporate clients got a win…
And North Carolinians got screwed.
Now, Whatley is trying to get to the U.S. Senate where he can keep advancing his toxic agenda.
He pushed for a bill that slashed Medicaid and risks health care coverage for hundreds of thousands of North Carolinians…
VIDEO OF WHATLEY: “And a huge win with the Big Beautiful Bill”
And while North Carolinians struggle to cover the cost of groceries, health care, and housing…
… Michael Whatley’s so out of touch that he claims:
VIDEO OF WHATLEY: “Gas prices are down. Grocery prices are down. Inflation is down”
AUDIO OF WHATLEY: “Inflation is dramatically down”
Michael Whatley can’t be trusted, because he’s only looking out for himself.

AI Talarcio: “Should have been a preacher.
“Oh and best for last!
“This video brings back memories of being the only teenage boy at Planned Parenthood’s March for Women’s Lives in 2004.”
Voice Over 1: “And that concludes our dramatic reading of James Talarico’s most memorable tweets.”

“This delay is courtesy of Senator Jon Ossoff.

“Georgia, you have a choice this November.
“Remember, Jon Ossoff put your safety and your travel at risk.”

title: NRSC Launches New Digital Ads to Promote Working Families Tax Cuts Across the Senate Map
text:
VO: “Remember when overtime didn’t always feel like yours?
“When tips didn’t always stay in your pocket?
“Working families deserved better.
“That’s why Senator Jon Husted passed President Trump’s Working Families Tax Cuts and delivered the largest tax cuts in history.
“Now, whether it’s overtime or tips, you keep what you earn.
“And in Ohio, that relief is real – with up to $6,100 more in wages, up to $9,800 more in take-home pay for a family of four, and 2.1 million seniors benefitting from no tax on Social Security.
“Senator Husted secured more than $202 million for rural healthcare in Ohio.
“And he extended tax deductions for nearly 141,000 of Ohio’s small businesses.
“That’s money back in your pocket and investments back into your communities.
“Senator Husted and President Trump kept their promise and delivered the largest tax cuts in history because you deserve to keep what you earn.”

title: NEW DIGITAL AD: Roy Cooper Put Men Back in Women’s Bathrooms

Roy Cooper : “It’s important that we remove this horrible requirement that transgender people had to go to the restroom of their birth certificate.

“House Bill 2 created a misguided, unworkable, and unnecessary requirement that individuals use the bathroom that matched the gender on their birth certificate.
“And I could not tolerate having House Bill 2 be the law of the land in North Carolina. I could not tolerate it another minute.”

Cooper campaigned for Governor on the promise to repeal HB2.
Cooper, a multimillionaire , worked with woke out of state CEOs who wanted to repeal HB2 and threatened to inflict economic pain on North Carolina.
But now Cooper doesn’t want to talk about HB2, refusing to speak with the Washington Post about fighting the legislation.
Cooper literally ran away when asked why he supports biological males in women’s sports and refused to say how many genders there are.
Cooper vetoed legislation banning biological males from women’s sports and barring children from receiving gender mutilation surgeries.

title: New Ad Campaign Slams Price Hike Mike Rogers for Dismissing Skyrocketing Michigan Gas Prices
text:
[TV ANCHOR 1] Metro Detroit gas prices are surging.
[TV ANCHOR 2] Gas prices have hit another new high.
[TV ANCHOR 3] Gas prices now up to $5 a gallon.
[NARRATOR] Gas prices are skyrocketing because of Trump’s war, and Michigan commuters are paying the price.
What does Mike Rogers have to say about it?
[MIKE ROGERS] We’re gonna be fine. We’ve got plenty of oil.
[REPORTER 1] Mike Rogers, the Republican from Michigan, downplayed the impact of the Iran War on gas prices.
[REPORTER 2] “We’ve got plenty of oil, we’re gonna be fine” is not really the message people want to hear when they’re paying five bucks a gallon for gas.
[NARRATOR] Price Hike Mike is out of touch.

title: TEAM ROGERS ANNOUNCES NEW AD ON INVESTING IN SKILLED TRADES

College debt soared.

Let’s put shop class back in every high school and train our kids for real jobs – jobs AI can’t eliminate. Jobs China can’t steal.
I’m Mike Rogers, and I approve this message because Michigan outworks everyone.

title: Hickenlooper Drops First Streaming, Digital Ad of Senate Reelection
text:
“I’m John Hickenlooper and this is me in 30 seconds.
“I started my career as a geologist but I got laid off. We opened the Wynkoop, the first brewpub in Colorado – still going strong!
“I served as Mayor of Denver, then Governor of Colorado. We expanded health care and cut pollution in order to fight climate change.
“As Senator, we stopped Trump from selling our public land, and we’re fighting to overhaul ICE and lower costs.
“But, the stakes are too high to slow down. So, let’s keep fighting.”

title: NRSC Slams Graham Platner in New Ad
text:
Voice Over: Susan Collins spent time as a kid picking potatoes in Maine.
Graham Platner spent time as a kid at a $70,000 a year prep school in Connecticut.
Susan Collins has brought more than $1.5 billion back to Maine for hospitals, schools, roads and communities across the state.
Graham Platner runs a hobby oyster farm whose only customer is his mother’s restaurant… Graham say hi to your mother for me okay?
Susan Collins doesn’t have a Nazi tattoo and she doesn’t have an account on a notorious predator’s paradise app.

text:
When chaos threatens to drown out competence… Experience Matters.
After a devastating attack on 9/11, Susan Collins led the way forward – enacting historic bipartisan reforms that made us safer.
During a pandemic……she wrote the law that saved 250,000 Maine jobs.
When unfair federal regulations threatened to crush Maines’s lobstermen…her law saved our coastal communities.
She protects access to quality healthcare…
And she delivered the Social Security Fairness Act… boosting the incomes of 25,000 Maine retirees.
Never missing a single vote – 10,000 in a row…
Maine’s first Chair of the powerful Appropriations Committee in a century…
Today, Maine sits at the head of the table.
With America’s most bipartisan Senator…
Always working for Maine.
I’m Susan Collins and I’ve approved this message.

title: Sarah Trone Garriott Launches First TV Ad of the Campaign
text: In scripture, it’s taught to be quick to listen and slow to speak. Well, Congress could stand to hear a verse or two. I’m Sarah Trone Garriott, as a Lutheran Minister and a State Senator, I make listening a priority, and what I hear is people are hurting. And Washington isn’t helping. That costs us. That’s why I say it’s time to pass term limits, require town halls, and ban politicians from trading stocks. That’s a message I definitely approve.

title: AD: ROGERS PROTECTS MICHIGAN MANUFACTURING, PUTS MAIN STREET OVER WALL STREET
text:
I grew up in a middle-class family in Livingston County, one of five boys.
I built cars to pay for college, and I have never forgotten where I came from.
When Wall Street wanted you to bail them out and protect their bonuses, I stood up to my party, and I voted no.
When America's auto industry needed a lifeline, I worked with both parties to save jobs, and I voted yes.
Because for me, Michigan always comes first.
I'm Mike Rogers, and I approve this message.

title: MIKE COLLINS FOR U.S. SENATE LAUNCHES NEW AD: “DELIVER”
text:
As a trucker, I couldn’t talk all day and never deliver. But that’s what Jon Ossoff does.
Ossoff talks healthcare, but voted to gut rural hospitals.
He voted for higher taxes on tips, overtime, even social security.
Ossoff talks a good game, but all he’s delivered is higher prices and unaffordable healthcare
I’m Mike Collins. I approve this message because I’m a trucker, not a talker.
And my 18-wheeler is ready to deliver.

title: New TV AD Highlights Troy Jackson’s Working Class Roots
text:

If you need help, he's gonna be there for you. That is who he is.
I'm Troy Jackson, this is my mom, and I approve this message.

title: NEW: DCCC Launches Digital Ad Campaign Targeting AANHPI Voters in NJ-07
text:
Families across New Jersey are under pressure.
Groceries, gas, medicine, childcare — everything costs more.
Corporations’ profits rise, while our families pay the price.
Rebecca Bennett is a former Navy pilot, a mom of two, and a health care advocate — she fights for New Jersey families like ours.
Now she’s running for Congress to do even more for us.
She’ll fight to lower the cost of groceries, bring down gas prices, and make health care and prescription drugs more affordable.
Rebecca Bennett: Fighting to lower costs for our families.

title: New Ad Highlights Troy Jackson’s Firsthand Experience Trying To Make Ends Meet For His Family
text:
It was a terrible feeling as a parent.
I'd work 80 hours a week in the woods, and there still wouldn't be enough at the end of the week. You know, I never got a chance to see my kids grow up, and I still didn't make enough for what we needed.
The people in power aren't suddenly going to make it easy for all of us.
That's why I've been fighting back to protect Social Security and Medicare, and to cut taxes for working people, because you should keep more of what you earn.
Mainers aren't looking for a handout, but we all deserve a fair shot.
I'm Troy Jackson, and I approve this message.

title: Snap video ad
text:
Hospital transparency and
insulin price cap bills advance
to Senate floor
- The Gazette 7/22/26
We're fighting to make hospitals
and insurers publish their prices,
and fine them if they don't.
No more surprise bills.
You deserve lower healthcare costs and
to know exactly what you're paying for.
Healthcare is a right, and this is an
important step in our fight
for universal coverage.

text:
DENYFA®
Hospital transparency and
insulin price cap bills advance
to Senate floor
- The Gazette 7/22/26
We're fighting to make hospitals
and insurers publish their prices,
and fine them if they don't.
No more surprise bills.
You deserve lower healthcare costs and
to know exactly what you're paying for.
Healthcare is a right, and this is an
important step in our fight
for universal coverage.

health and ultimately protecting the health of future generations of islands.

The most existential threat currently facing
Iowans is the continuing worsening and degradation of our water resources.
As the situation has worsened and cancer rates have risen despite them falling
on a national level, Iowa's second congressional district rep, Ashley Henson,
has taken actions to make the problem worse.
Cancer rates in Iowa are some of the highest in the entire country.
In her last term, she voted to strip regulations around protections for
sources of drinking water and also voted to defund two separate programs designed to support
access to clean drinking water all while taking $300,000 of contributions from corporate polluters.
This is not a partisan issue. A majority of islands in a recent poll, including 72% of Republicans,
said they were more likely to support a candidate who prioritized clean drinking water.
So it just blows my mind that we have politicians so willing to go so strongly against public sentiment.
So someone please tell Ashley Hinson that she needs to start prioritizing clean drinking water.

title: Sarah Trone Garriott Launches New TV Ad, “Hard”
text:
On my very first night as a hospital chaplain
I baptized two babies as the NICU staff fought to save them
Everyday, I comforted families on the worst day of their life
I’m Sarah Trone Garriott
After that, no conversation feels hard
Unlike Zach Nunn, I won’t run from accountability
I approve this message because we have to clean up the corruption in Washington
And I’m not afraid to tell the politicians and lobbyists that their days of helping themselves are over
To me, that’s not hard at all

title: NEW: Josh Turek for Iowa Releases New Ad, “Went Through Hell”
text:
[JOHN TUREK]: Vietnam – I spent 22 months over there. They were using Agent Orange that caused my son, Josh Turek, to be born with spina bifida.
I went through the war, but Josh went through Hell.
He knows better than most what Iowans are going through now. Washington taking away healthcare coverage. People forced to travel hours to see a doctor.
Josh is a fighter, and he will take this personal. He really wants to improve people’s lives. He won’t ever stop working to make it right.
[JOSH TUREK]: I’m Josh Turek, and I approve this message.

I’m Dr. Amish Shah and I approve this message because I’ll never let politics get in the way of saving lives.

title: DCCC Releases First TV Ad in WI-01: “Bucks”
text:
Mitchell Berman: “Bryan Steil’s done pretty well for himself in Washington.
His net worth more than doubled.
His stock portfolio? One of Congress’s best.
Bryan Steil and I both chase bucks. Difference is, mine has antlers.
I’m Mitchell Berman.
I don’t own stocks. I don’t take corporate PAC money and never will.
I’ll ban members of Congress from trading stocks
Because public service shouldn’t be about getting rich.
I approve this message because Washington should work for us, not whoever cuts the check.”

Last week, Cook Political Report recently shifted WI-01 in Democrats’ direction to “Lean Republican.” Cook writes in part that WI-01 “looks increasingly like a competitive race.”
Earlier this year, Supreme Court Justice Chris Taylor carried Wisconsin’s First District by 15 points and won four out of the five counties in the district.

Bill Huizenga took thousands from data center companies, utilities, Big Oil.

And voted himself a fifty thousand dollar tax break.
I say: enough.
Ban congressional stock trading.
No dark money in elections.
And if you’re corrupt, Democrat or Republican, you go to jail.
Bill Huizenga got rich playing the game.
It’s time to change the rules.”

To lower costs and make sure the care you need doesn’t get denied just so corporations can make more money.
Because whether it’s your family or mine, nobody should go broke taking care of the people they love.
I’m Josh Riley, and I approve this message.”

title: DCCC Releases New TV Ad in NY-17: “Pain”
text:
Mike Lawler once told us that rising prices were “a little bit of short-term pain.”
But that pain you’re feeling at the pump, at the grocery store, and on your utility bill is no accident.
Mike Lawler votes with Trump 100% of the time.
For Trump’s tariffs, for Trump’s war in Iran.
And what does he get in return?
Millions in attack ads from Trump and his MAGA allies.
So when Mike Lawler calls high prices “a little bit of short-term pain…”
Well Mike, it won’t go away until you do.
“I’m Cait Conley and I approve this message.”

title: DCCC Releases New TV Ad in VA-02: “Two Choices”
text:

You run, or you fight.
Jen Kiggans runs.
From reporters.

To bring down costs.
And ban stock trading in Congress.
I’m Elaine Luria, and I approve this message.
Because you’ve got two choices.
And I never run from a fight.

title: DCCC Releases New TV Ad in AL-02: “Footsteps”
text:
Congressman Figures: It’s not easy following in big footsteps.
Public service defines my mother’s life.
My dad, a civil rights lawyer.
They taught me about sacrifice and service.
To believe in and fight for the people of Alabama.
In Congress, I’ve fought to lower prices, restore funding to Medicaid, save our rural hospitals, and protect Social Security.
I’m Shomari Figures and I approve this message.

text:
Hey, series question. Have you made your plan to vote? Don't sit these midterm elections out.
As a Nevada, your vote will have more impact than ever in deciding some of our most key races.
Right here in Congressional District 2, Teresa Bonita's Thompson is our Democratic candidate,
and she is running on issues that matter to us students, including affordability
and finding jobs after graduation. Head to iBullVote.com to check your voter registration today,
find your nearest polling location, and then send it to your friends and to your group chats.
Voting is simple and easy and we have a location right here on campus, so make
sure to vote and vote early.
serious
Benitez-Thompson

title: DCCC Releases New Coordinated TV Ad in TN-05: “Shows Up”
text:
Tennessean: Chaz Molder always shows up for us.
Tennessean: Whether it’s passing eight balanced budgets without raising taxes.
Tennessean: Or fighting against a broken Washington.
Tennessean: We know we can count on Chaz.
Tennessean: But when we needed funding for our schools?
Tennessean: Or when farmers needed help!
Tennessean: Charlie Hatcher was nowhere to be found.
Tennessean: So I’m voting for the guy that always has our back.
Tennesseans (all together): Chaz Molder for Congress.
Chaz Molder: I’m Chaz Molder, and I approve this message. Because I’ll always show up for you.
